_version_note: current_version tracks @twemoji/svg on npm, whose latest is 15.0.0. It read 17.0.0, which has never been published -- `npm pack` failed with an empty message and the pack shipped zero SVGs (V4). It is NOT the Unicode emoji version (16.0) nor the OpenMoji release (17.0.0); all three move independently and version_check_url above is the authority for this one.
_note: icon-sets-emoji runs the emoji-sets recipe, named in `recipe` (src/internal/core/recipes), which syncs Twemoji (npm) categorised by the Unicode emoji taxonomy; OpenMoji is icon-sets-openmoji's. The git-branch sink below is where that recipe commits; its Unicode version is the emoji.unicode_version setting.
